statement: The booking record places Ms Farrell’s knee replacement on Thursday but lists the left side, which conflicts with the surgeon’s and signed consent’s right-knee designation; I will therefore list the operation for the right knee.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the record's "left" side "conflicts with the surgeon's and signed consent's right-knee designation" and corrects it to the right knee.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
